parameters.content:
### Read me first
Owner-in-the-loop social poster for The Miners Arms. Every Telegram reply/photo from the 3 owner chat IDs lands here and gets routed by a `route` code. Companion to `MINERS-Social-Initiation` (which starts the conversation) — this workflow carries it through to a finished, approved asset. Delivery ends at Telegram; auto-posting to FB/IG/TikTok was cancelled by Prakhar, posting is manual.

### Entry — parse & route every Telegram update
Every Telegram update (button tap or photo/text message) from the 3 allow-listed owner chat IDs lands here. `Parse Reply` extracts the `route` + `sessionId` from callback data, or detects `msg:photo` / `msg:post`. Callback taps get acknowledged (stop the spinner) + a short ack text. `Route Step` is the master switch — 12 routes + a fallback.

### Conversation branches — Yes/No → Picture/Video → Upload/Generate
Handles the early yes/no and picture-or-video choices. `q1:y` asks picture-or-video; `q1:n` records cancelled. `q2:pic` asks upload-your-own vs AI-generate; `q2:vid` skips straight to requesting a food photo (video always needs one to animate).

### Request the food photo (own-photo path)
`q2b:own` — owner chose to upload their own food photo instead of AI-generating one from the gallery. Sends the request and sets state to `awaiting_uploaded_photo`.

### Final review — approve / cancel / regenerate
Handles the owner's verdict on a generated draft. `q3:ok` marks it approved (delivery ends here — posting is manual, not automated). `q3:cx` cancels. `q3:rg`/`q3:rv` loop back into the generate or video pipelines to try again.

### AI-generate path — gallery photo + Gemini edit (Phase 2a)
`q2b:gen` (and the `q3:rg` regenerate loop) land here. Fetches a random real gallery photo from the website, has Gemini write a caption, then Gemini image-edit overlays branded social graphics directly onto the gallery photo. Sends the result for approve/regenerate/cancel.

### Photo received — session lookup & type dispatch
Handles any incoming Telegram photo (`msg:photo`) or a video retry (`q3:rv`). `Pick Latest Session` sorts by `created_at DESC` to find the newest in-flight session — this fixes a real bug where an old abandoned row could hijack the flow, don't reintroduce a bare `limit:1`. `Session Guard` bails out gracefully if nothing is open. `Image or Video?` then dispatches on the session's `media_type`.

### Manual test shortcut
Typing "post" directly to the bot (`msg:post`) re-runs the same kickoff logic as the scheduled `MINERS-Social-Initiation` workflow, for testing without waiting for Mon/Wed/Fri 10am.

### Fallback — unrecognized input
Catches any `route` that doesn't match a known code (stale button after a workflow update, unauthorized chat ID, etc.) and tells the user their input wasn't understood.

### ⚠️ Video pipeline (Veo 3.1) — FROZEN, do not modify without explicit request
Turns the owner's food photo into an 8s vertical video via Gemini's Veo 3.1 `predictLongRunning` API (base64 image-to-video), polling every 40s until done. Confirmed working 2026-07-03. It broke once already when Google retired `veo-3.0-generate-001` — if it 404s again, re-probe available models with `explore_node_resources` (`videoGenerationModelSearch`) and bump the model ID; don't redesign the architecture.

**2026-08-10 — RAI audio-filter guard added (exec 4643).**
Veo returns `done: true` even when its safety filter blocks the clip (`raiMediaFilteredCount`, no `generatedSamples`). `Video Ready?` only checks `done`, so a filtered result used to reach `Extract Video Binary` and throw, killing the run silently. Now:
- **`Video Produced?`** checks a real `generatedSamples[0].video.uri` before extracting.
- **`Retry Video?`** resubmits (3 attempts total) — the filter is non-deterministic and filtered attempts aren't charged.
- **`Send Video Failed` → `State: video failed`** tells the owner and parks the session at `awaiting_uploaded_photo` so they can recover.
- `Build Video Prompt` now sets an explicit benign **Audio:** line. Veo 3.1 audio is always on — `generateAudio:false` is **Vertex-only** (Gemini API returns 400) and silent `veo-2.0` is retired (404), so audio must be steered, not disabled.
- `Check Video Status` resolves the op via `$json.operationName || $json.name` so the poll loop follows retries instead of a stale `.first()` operation.

### Own-photo composite pipeline (Phase 2b) — remove.bg + Gemini Files API
Composites the owner's uploaded food photo onto a real gallery background: remove.bg cuts out the food, both images are uploaded via Gemini Files API HTTP calls (not inline base64 — n8n Code nodes in this version can't read binary data), then Gemini 3.1 Flash Image composites them with a prompt that keeps the dish itself untouched.

nodes.name: Video Produced?
nodes.notes: Veo sets done:true even when the RAI safety filter blocks the clip. Only a generatedSamples[0].video.uri means a real video exists.

nodes.name: Retry Video?
nodes.notes: Veo's audio filter is non-deterministic and filtered attempts are not charged, so resubmit. $runIndex < 2 gives 3 total submissions.

nodes.name: Send Video Failed

=⚠️ Sorry — I couldn't make that video.

Google's Veo safety filter blocked the soundtrack it generated for your photo. This happens at random and isn't anything you did wrong. I already tried 3 times.

Tap 🔁 Try again, or just send me the photo again.

nodes.notes: Tells the owner the video was blocked instead of leaving the chat silent.

nodes.name: State: video failed
nodes.notes: Parks the session back at awaiting_uploaded_photo and keeps the file_id so both recovery routes work.

nodes.name: Fetch Retry Row
nodes.notes: retry_video callbacks carry the session id, so look the row up by id rather than by status.
